title: Stoichiometry and Reactions - Chemistry - Reaction Types
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: The reaction $2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2 + \text{O}_2$ is an example of:
questions.explain: A decomposition reaction involves a single compound breaking down into two or more simpler substances.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which type of reaction is represented by: $\text{Zn} + \text{CuSO}_4 \rightarrow \text{ZnSO}_4 + \text{Cu}$?
questions.explain: In a single replacement reaction, one element replaces another element in a compound (Zn replaces Cu).
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: A reaction where a hydrocarbon reacts with oxygen to produce carbon dioxide and water is classified as:
questions.explain: Combustion is the reaction of a substance (often a hydrocarbon) with oxygen, releasing energy, CO$_2$, and H$_2$O.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.explain: This is a double replacement reaction where the cations and anions of two different compounds switch places.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: The equation $2\text{Mg} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{MgO}$ is best classified as:
questions.explain: Two simple substances combine to form a more complex substance. This is synthesis (or combination).
questions.subject: Chemistry
